og.alt: Virtual: A hundred thousand rows. Twenty in the DOM. 3.25× faster unmount of a 10,000-row virtual list than @tanstack/react-virtual (20 vs 65 µs)

hero.alt: Schematic: a scroll track stands for 100,000 rows; a viewport shows the rows around row 41,200. Each scroll step adds the two rows coming into view and removes the two going out, while the rows that stay do no work. A counter shows about twenty rows in the DOM at every position, overscan included.
